mentions.name: rainfrog
mentions.description: Rainfrog is a terminal UI database tool that recently added autocomplete. It is built as a lightweight, keyboard-centric alternative to dbeaver and pgAdmin, and covers the vast majority of the author's day-to-day database tasks.
mentions.problem: Existing database tools like dbeaver and pgAdmin are heavyweight and not keyboard-centric; rainfrog offers a lightweight, keyboard-driven alternative.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I recently added autocomplete to rainfrog, the terminal UI database tool I've been working on: https://github.com/achristmascarl/rainfrog

I initially made it as a lightweight, keyboard-centric alternative to dbeaver/pgadmin, and it now covers 95%+ of the database-related tasks I need to do at my job.
